recommendation: Keep this source-changing commit. It preserves the existing FHIR-20846 design while making the active narrative and CodeSystem surfaces consistently guide implementers to the FHIRPath factory API; revisit only if FHIR-I changes the draft factory API signatures themselves.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification request to align StructureMap target transform functions with FHIRPath by documenting required integrated FHIRPath support, cross-checking transform functions with FHIRPath functions, and defining factories for common FHIR datatypes on the FHIRPath page.
initial_application: Commit 662229e4296562444046aeac9c485f03292d1a34 applied the issue by adding the FHIRPath requirement to Mapping Language and StructureMap introduction text, adding a FHIRPath-equivalent column to the target-transform table, adding a FHIRPath Type Factory section, and adding a fhirpath property to CodeSystem/map-transform. That application left factory-backed transform CodeSystem properties as n/a and left several implementer-visible factory text/example defects.
additional_context: The edited files are active current-build sources: source/hierarchy.xml lists fhirpath.html, mapping-language.html, and the StructureMap resource, while source/fhir.ini lists StructureMap as active. Later FHIR-40645 work touched the same mapping-language table and transform CodeSystem for date/time transforms but did not supersede the FHIR-20846 factory alignment. Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive community evidence changing the Jira/source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/structuremap/codesystem-map-transform.xml so cc, c, qty, id, and cp expose the same %factory equivalents already shown in the mapping-language table. Corrected the adjacent mapping-language factory link markup and quantity typo. Corrected the FHIRPath Type Factory examples and parameter text for Extension, HumanName.family, Coding, withExtension, and withProperty.
source_changes: source/fhirpath.html: corrected Type Factory example casing, invalid examples, HumanName.family wording, and misleading general factory examples.
source/mapping-language.html: fixed malformed factory links in the Target Transform table and corrected the quantity text typo.
source/structuremap/codesystem-map-transform.xml: aligned fhirpath properties for cc, c, qty, id, and cp with the documented %factory equivalents.

related_jiras.note: Later date/time transform reconciliation changed the same Mapping Language table and CodeSystem, confirming build scope but not superseding the FHIR-20846 factory alignment.
